freezeStage: Kit identities and source plan, before original downloads
provenanceEnrichment: Separate per-kit details and intake records; registry never rewritten

selection.method: Purposive stratified metadata-only intake from official OMR catalog snapshots. Distinct kit numbers only; no mesh, stud, collision, solver, policy, or benchmark outcome inspected. All selected original profiles remain in the denominator. This is not random sampling of the entire OMR.
selection.preexistingKitExclusion: All existing web/public/models manifests, grouped by kit number, including alternate builds.
notes: Theme/title strata are intake metadata, not verified physical capability labels.
Architecture avoids same-landmark replacement editions in the selected list.
Small animal/aircraft sources are retained whole, not relabeled as multiple independent profiles.
Kit-level independence is operational bookkeeping, not a claim that designs/authors share no construction conventions.
One source per kit; no admission-based replacement after freeze.
